pipeline_run.tool_results_note: What the run's two MCP steps returned. Microsoft Learn's page excerpts (each result's content) are dropped; the pipeline reads only title and contentUrl. Replaying these through compiled/extracted reproduces output.

fields.name: reading_list
fields.why: Microsoft Learn search over a live index: which pages rank in the first five, their order, their titles and their URLs change as docs are published, retitled or moved. The shape holds: five bullets, each a linked title.

fields.name: repo_outline
fields.why: DeepWiki regenerates a repo's wiki from the repo, so page names and numbering change when it re-indexes. Slower than the search results: the outline's first pages read the same on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-22.

drift.observed: Over these three runs, eight minutes from first to last, nothing drifted: both pipeline runs got byte-identical tool results (all ten search results, excerpts included, and the wiki outline) and returned the same digest, and the agent's digest was the same text without the pipeline's trailing newline. Against a run recorded on 2026-10-20 (tests/fixtures/mcp_results/docs_digest.json), the first two search results and the start of the outline were also unchanged.
drift.expected: Over days and weeks: the reading list (ranking, titles, URLs) first, the repo outline slowly. The input, the section headings, the number of reading-list bullets and the outline's opening line ('Available pages for <repo>:') are not live data.
drift.quirks: Microsoft Learn returns several chunks of one page as separate results, so the first five can repeat a URL (four of the five recorded links are the same page). The skill and the pipeline both keep the repeats, as the skill says to.
